title: NEAR Protocol Launches $250K Hackathon Requiring No Signup
summary:
Developers can now build cross-chain markets and agentic applications to secure prizes for the network's latest coding event. The competition requires no formal signup and offers more than $250,000 in total rewards for participants who ship a public repository and demo post between Nov 1 and Nov 14 at 23:59 UTC. Entries must utilize technologies such as NEAR Intents, chain signatures, chain abstraction, and NEAR AI Cloud, with a specific focus on confidentiality.

Judging for the contest will be led by Helius CEO Mert and ilblackdragon, together with investors from a16z crypto, Electric Capital, and Dragonfly. The NEAR Foundation Council is promoting the initiative as a way to create a "market of markets" with connected liquidity at planetary scale, which Mert described as a necessary step for the crypto industry to succeed across different chains.
